plugins.name: haiku-warning
plugins.description: Shows a red warning above the prompt while a Haiku model is selected

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: One-line band above the prompt: context, 5-hour and 7-day limits and cost, in graphite tones

plugins.name: desk-garden
plugins.description: A desk by a window with a flowerpot in a pane; a workshop below reacts to what Claude is doing. Opens with /garden

plugins.name: reef-tank
plugins.description: A tall aquarium pane: fish, seahorse, jellyfish; at work the light darkens and a yellow submarine dives. Opens with /reef

plugins.name: tower-cut
plugins.description: A tall building cross-section pane: every finished turn adds a floor; at 20 floors the tower tops out with fireworks. Opens with /tower

plugins.name: jungle-falls
plugins.description: A tall jungle pane: terraced waterfalls wind into a lily pool and 24 kinds of animals drop by at random; night while Claude works. Opens with /falls

plugins.name: rain-window
plugins.description: A tall rainy-window pane: drops run down the glass, city lights blur outside, a cat dozes on the sill; storm and lightning while Claude works, a rainbow when done. Opens with /rain

plugins.name: moon-view
plugins.description: A tall pane on the Moon looking at the Earth: a lander and a bouncing astronaut below, and planets, a black hole, rockets, a UFO and starships passing at random. Opens with /moon

plugins.name: night-train
plugins.description: A tall night-train window pane: waits at a lamp-lit station at rest; while Claude works hills, trees and poles stream past and tunnels flash by, then it pulls in again. Opens with /train

plugins.name: beach-day
plugins.description: A tall top-down beach pane: gentle waves, sunbathers in sunglasses under parasols, swimmers on rings with a pink unicorn among them; a jet ski and a banana boat while Claude works. Opens with /beach

plugins.name: snow-cabin
plugins.description: A tall snowy-cabin pane: soft snowfall over a white forest and snowy peaks, a white rabbit, a white fox and a magpie; at work night falls, the windows glow, the chimney smokes and snowmen are built one by one. Opens with /snow

plugins.name: deep-sub
plugins.description: A tall deep-sea pane: a submersible among glowing jellyfish, an anglerfish, lanternfish and something vast below; at work the searchlight comes on, sonar pings and a giant squid's shadow sweeps past. Opens with /deep

plugins.name: campfire
plugins.description: A tall campfire pane in a deep forest under the stars: flickering flames, crackling sparks, flowers round the clearing, a passing fox and an owl that swivels its head; the fire roars while Claude works and dies back after. Opens with /fire
